A raw-page spot check is advised, above all the dates the summaries gave without a quotation (Vandals page: Pyrenees crossing 13 October 409; Rhine crossing 31 December 405).

Handover choices to align with other groups: visigoths ends 418 (visigothic-kingdom found 418, same year, different land); vandals ends 434 (vandal-kingdom found 435); alans ends 418 with a merge event to vandals; saxons ends 804 (Cliopatria's last Saxon shape is 799).
